entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A prodigy Quandrix mage and graduate student at Strixhaven who solved the Vorzani Conjecture and later researches the structure of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The magical university on Arcavios whose colleges include Quandrix.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of mathematical magic that Zimone attends.

entities.name: Nimiroti
entities.description: Zimone's grandmother, a former Quandrix professor who solved the Vorzani Conjecture, was captured by the Oriq and erased her own memory.

entities.name: Zihir Wola
entities.description: One of Zimone's two fathers.

entities.name: Dipo Wola
entities.description: One of Zimone's two fathers.

entities.name: Vorzani Conjecture
entities.description: A famous unsolved magical theorem that holds the key to the universe's essence, which Zimone solves.

entities.name: Dean Kianne
entities.description: A dean of Strixhaven who tries to stop Zimone's reading and later helps rescue her; Zimone's mentor.

entities.name: Dean Imbraham
entities.description: A dean of Strixhaven blamed by Kianne for influencing Zimone.

entities.name: Codie
entities.description: A living book who tells Zimone what happened to her grandmother.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Sinister mages who captured Nimiroti and later Zimone.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Leader of the Oriq who wants Zimone's knowledge to control time and space.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Witherbloom student and friend with whom Zimone blends magics.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor who sends surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: A surviving student who is distracted by the compleated Nassari.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A student whose spark ignites during the invocation and who planeswalks away.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A surviving student in the invocation group.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: A compleated Phyrexian who distracts Rootha.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A magical rite in the Biblioplex that repels the Phyrexian attackers when each school contributes.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack that burns through Strixhaven's defenses.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who opens an Omenpath to Duskmourn using Alquist Proft's magic.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A character who joins the rescue of Nashi and later visits Arcavios with Zimone.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A character who is separated with Zimone in the House on Duskmourn.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A member of the group seeking Nashi, later captured by the cult.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A captive on Duskmourn whom the group seeks to save.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A nightmarish plane centered on a shifting House, taken over by Valgavoth.

entities.name: Primo
entities.description: A fractal Zimone created on the mission to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A teenage-seeming girl whose actions enabled Valgavoth to take over the House.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The entity that grew and consumed the House and effectively took over Duskmourn.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Cultists who capture Nashi's rescuers in a ceremonial chamber.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A figure whose magic Kaito uses to open an Omenpath.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: The source of a fateshifter who became part of the House.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who commissioned a map of the Multiverse and offers Zimone an apprenticeship.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who co-offers Zimone an apprenticeship.

entities.name: Lumia Voj
entities.description: The Izzet archmage under whom Zimone would study.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of researchers Zimone works alongside.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whose image is revealed as someone who knew the person copying the Multiverse.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Zimone works on her thesis and later research.

events.summary: Zimone's grandmother Nimiroti had solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq, then cast a memory-loss spell on herself.
events.quote: Nimiroti had to cast a memory loss spell on herself to erase her knowledge of the Conjecture from her mind

events.summary: The Oriq capture Zimone, and Extus Narr wants her knowledge; Zimone rescues him when Kianne and her friends come, showing she has mastered time and space.
events.quote: she demonstrated that she had mastered time and space, and thus had solved the Vorzani Conjecture

events.summary: Rumors that Zimone is in league with the Oriq isolate her; she eventually finds Nimiroti at a sanctuary for people damaged by magic.
events.quote: Zimone eventually found Nimiroti at a sanctuary for people damaged by magic.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
events.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

events.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix and Witherbloom magic to fight, discovering new interdisciplinary magic.
Zimone travels to Ravnica and joins Kaito, Niko, Tyvar and the Wanderer to rescue Nashi from Duskmourn.
events.quote: At some point on this mission, Zimone created a fractal known as Primo .

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone are separated in a shifting library, attacked by a spider-like creature and flee.
events.quote: forcing Tyvar and Zimone to flee deeper into the library to escape the relentless threat

events.summary: A phantom of Dean Kianne tries to lure Zimone, and Tyvar's camouflage nearly merges them with the House.
events.quote: allowing them to evade further threats

events.summary: Zimone and Tyvar find Marina Vendrell and her diary, learning she enabled Valgavoth to consume the House and take over the plane.
events.quote: Marina had enabled Valgavoth to grow and consume everything around him

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath Kaito opens from Ravnica.
events.quote: Kaito, who had retreated to Ravnica, used Alquist Proft 's magic to open an artificial Omenpath from Ravnica to Duskmourn

events.summary: Niko and Tyvar accompany Zimone back to Arcavios, and she finishes her graduate degree.
events.quote: Zimone completed her graduate degree by c. 4565 AR .

events.summary: Zimone models the Multiverse, concludes someone is copying it from Arcavios, and identifies Chandra Nalaar via a psychic-signature spell with Dina.
events.quote: Zimone concluded that someone was creating a parallel copy of the Multiverse, using Arcavios as a starting point.
